what_happened: Scratch prototypes compiled with plain 'lake env lean' against existing oleans settled the design question by measurement: per-language derived-operator bodies generated from one signature definition are structurally identical to the tree's in 63 of 63 cases, and naive delegation to the signature operator was measured to break constructor-keyed rw/simp.

Task description says eighteen doubled derived operators but lists seventeen names; measured intersection of Formula and PlusFormula definitions is 17, one of which (reflectTime) is a structural recursion that no signature class can carry.

Plan-time re-validation: research report cites GenericSchemata under Semantics/ context and a 6-file rebase; live path is FormalSystem/Metalogic/SoundnessLemmas/GenericSchemata.lean at 1440 lines (60 below the 1500 longFile ceiling), and clause-class names appear in 19 tracked Lean files. Temporal contribution (PR 8) is still open and CONFLICTING; TemporalIntervals.lean is now on main.
